profile.headline: Ph.D. Control Systems Engineering
profile.summary: Mission-driven engineer. Gravitates toward safety-critical domains. Dedicated to software quality excellence. High quality software is easy to work with, increases development speed, lowers cost, and lowers user risk.

positions.title: Senior Controls Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Refactor Software Architecture for Quality Excellence
+ Refactor product code for improved maintainability, understandability, and extensibility for faster application-layer software development and reduced defect density, primarily in Simulink
+ Infuse software quality principles into the code base such as low complexity and coupling, modularization, separation of concern, single sources of truth, and enforced architectural layering
+ Develop engineering test suites to support refactoring such as functional equivalence tests 
+ Contribute to enterprise software development process maturity such as trunk-based development, build-time feature configuration, and scaffold patterns to support major architectural shifts
+ Cost of software development for new instrument software on Hugo RAS went from twelve FTE over two years in 2023 to four FTE over nine months in 2026
Project: Rapid Technical Risk Burndown to Acquire Fortimedix
Project: Rapid Prototype Endoluminal Robot

positions.title: Controls Software Engineer, Scrum Master, Product Owner
positions.description:
Project: Instrument controls development for Hugo robotic-assisted surgery platform
+Software development for robotics control systems
+Development for Class C medical device software
+Agile software development methodology
+Controller design for cable-driven robotic end effectors
+Product planning and management

positions.title: Technology Lead, Cofounder
positions.description:
Project: Customer discovery investigations to identify true customer needs
+ Conduct interviews of professionals and workers from diverse occupations in an open-response manner to minimize response bias
+ Compile interview notes and extract themes to identify paths forward for the company
+ Identify, elicit, and pursue new interview leads through cold calls and network introductions

Project: Invent and produce an ultra-reliable fast-acting tourniquet for military and civilian use
+ Co-lead design of the product suite
+ Create analytical deformation models for tourniquet actuation mechanisms
+ Fabricate prototypes for lab testing
+ Identify system specifications with design tools such as FMEA and Feature Comparison Tables
+ Develop mechanical models for limbs using academic literature
+ Program feature specification calculator applications for use by the Engineering team
+ Supervise and advise intern

Project: Invent a smart BFR cuff with biosensing and closed-loop feedback
+ Design algorithms for capturing plethysmography signals from noisy sensor data in real time

Project: Invent a rugged non-invasive field thermometer for use in austere prehospital environments
+ Aggregate and summarize physiological thermal sensing literature, hyperthermia and hypothermia medical literature, and material science literature

positions.title: Engineering Lead
positions.description:
Project: Invent novel AFM attachment for viroid scanning and identification
+ Contributed technical perspective to grant proposals and other funding documentation
+ Identified and procured material and equipment needs for a brand new lab
+ Aggregated relevant academic literature to identify gaps in existing technology and garner competitive advantages for the firm
+ Provided systems and control engineering perspective to the multi-disciplinary team

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Project: Develop analytical specimen models for varied mechanical testing conditions
+ Developed an analytical model for a specimen undergoing four-point bending which produces maps for stress, strain, and non-ideal bending deformation phenomena such as anticlastic bending
+ Developed an analytical model for a specimen undergoing simultaneous axial and transverse loading
+ Wrote technical memos for client internal circulation which recommend limits of agreement between instrument measurements and standard models for mechanical testing
+ Maintained timely, professional, and courteous contact with client regarding project needs and deliverables

positions.title: Research Assistant, PhD Candidate
positions.description:
Project: Advanced control for AFM
+ Devised a novel dual-actuator coordination algorithm for subresonance tapping (SRT) mode on the atomic force microscope (AFM) that exploits unique features of the SRT deflection curve
+ Simulated the AFM operating in SRT mode in MATLAB Simulink, a computationally stiff problem
+ Designed, fabricated, and validated economical nanopositioners for dual-stage actuation
+ High-fidelity system characterization for piezoelectric stage actuators
+ Synthesized high-order linear models for the actuators for high accuracy simulations
+ Wrote LabVIEW code for control of the nanopositioning actuators via FPGA, digital signal processing, and data extraction

Project: Manual system identification for frequency response data
+ Formalized the model reconstruction algorithm so that features are matched from low frequency to high frequency
+ Configured first and second order transfer function structures to take a form such that the parameters are easily derived from the Bode plot of the frequency response data, including derivations of new formulas
+ Compiled the library of first and second order structures so that the method is generalized beyond stable and minimum-phase zero models (addressing a problem of 2*pi ambiguity)

Project: Soft robotics terrestrial locomotion, SquMA Bot
+ Designed power system and digital signal system for simultaneous operation of six Pololu motors and drivers with quadrature encoder feedback while mitigating hazards to handlers and the robot itself
+ Designed and validated control algorithm for motor position control and executed using LabVIEW FPGA
+ Provided a mechanical engineering and control systems engineering perspective to an interdisciplinary team
+ Supervised and mentored junior researchers

Project: Wearable navigational devices
+ Designed and fabricated a vibrotactile belt compass and a helmet-based binaural compass
+ Integrated virtual environment orientation feedback to navigational devices using Unity

positions.title: Senior Resident Assistant
positions.description:
In addition to the responsibilities for a staff Resident Assistant:
+ Modelled professionalism, integrity, and team-orientation for the junior RAs on staff
+ Provided administrative assistance for the Residence Director
+ Workshopped and approved programming paperwork for the staff
+ Planned and executed all scheduling needs for the staff
+ Advised Hall Council executive board on programming content, execution, and paperwork
+ Misc. responsibilities such as RA interviews, RA training, RA recruitment info sessions, Host Hall Council elections

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project: Develop high efficiency rare-earth-free permanent magnets
+ Provided mechanical perspective and complementary skill set for the materials science team
+ Developed and tested two novel milling techniques to prevent sample oxidation
+ Aided in data analysis efforts using crystal structure and magnetic characterization techniques
+ Developed unique device for use in a Magnetic Force Microscope (MFM) that applies a magnetic flux to a sample
+ Conducted literature searches as needed using journal databases and hard copy searches

positions.description:

+ Planned and executed at least 5 programs per semester which have intentional learning outcomes for the residents
+ Acted as a resource and role model for the residents, helping with personal or community issues
+ Walked rounds in the building, fostering a safe and comfortable environment for the community
+ Completed administrative duties for the management of the building

positions.title: SSL Tech
positions.description:
Project: Develop high-accuracy color quantum dot optics for use with blue LED sources in solid state lighting applications
+ Developed and executed two production reliability tests, then reported findings for customer use
+ Fabricated, remodeled, or repaired eight light engines and seven test fixtures
+ Utilized basic machining skills, knowledge of standard parts, hand work with small and delicate parts, and soldering
+ Self-taught knowledge of Colorimetry and led training of new co-op
+ Obtained knowledge in designing for manufacturability, system engineering, and thermal testing
+ Performed optical testing for experimental products and analyzed and reported findings

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering R&D Co-Op
positions.description:
Project: Manufacture and improve internally implantable pump to deliver morphine for use in pain management
Project: Manufacture and improve remotely operated robotic catheter manipulator
+ Used SolidWorks to draft or revise forty product drawings and three tool drawings
+ Wrote or significantly revised ten manufacturing procedures, five test procedures, two inspection procedures, and thirty engineering change orders
+ Developed two test protocols and test reports & designed two manufacturing tools
+ Completed all work in accordance with FDA compliance

positions.description:

+ Checked identification for all incoming individuals to residence halls
+ Logged all guests of residents

patents.title: Feedback correction in sub-resonant tapping mode of an atomic force microscope
patents.description: A method of carrying out sub-resonant tapping in an atomic force microscope includes causing a probe that is disposed above a sample to be translated in a direction parallel to a horizontal plane defined by the sample and to oscillate in a vertical direction that is perpendicular to the horizontal plane about an equilibrium line that is separated from the horizontal plane by a vertical offset. As a result, the probe repeatedly taps a surface of the sample. Each tap begins with a first contact of the probe on the surface followed by a progressive increase in force exerted by the sample on the probe until a peak force is attained. The vertical offset is controlled by relying at least in part on a feature other than the peak force as a basis for controlling the vertical offset.
